Changes: (1) presets.py: added split_jobs, sfm_flavor, sfm_est_minutes fields to QualityPreset; cost() returns combined estimate; enabled split on standard+refine. (2) runners/__init__.py: exported RATE_TABLE_SOURCE. (3) pipeline.py: _run_reconstruction branches on preset.split_jobs; _run_split_remote_reconstruction chains Job A (cpu-upgrade --sfm-only) then Job B (l4x1 --train-only) with processed_min.zip handed off via extra_repo_inputs. (4) recon_entrypoint.py: added --sfm-only (exit after COLMAP, writes processed_min.zip) and --train-only (skip COLMAP, unpack processed_min.zip, run ns-train) flags. Both work with --refine-mode. (5) tests: 85 passing (added split_job_routes and split_job_preset_cost tests). (6) README: updated cost table.

Root cause: ALIASES map was migrated as a constant but adaptWorkImpact never actually invoked it, so live data showed raw names like vaultwares-pipelines instead of vaultwares-api. The 14 compound/junk aliases I added yesterday + the FORKS list also did not survive. Fixes: (1) aliases.ts now has 14 added compound/namespace/meta-workspace aliases plus FORKS readonly array for OneTrainer + video-depth-anything, plus normalizeProject + isOwnedProject helpers. (2) src/api.ts adaptWorkImpact now applies, in order: WORK_IMPACT_CUTOFF 2026-03-11 filter, alias normalization on byProject and totalProjects (via per-day project lists), fork drop, zero-fill of daySeries between cutoff and last seen day, recompute streakCurrent + streakLongest over the zero-filled series, format busiestWeek as date range Apr 20-26 via isoWeekToRange. (3) adapter.test.ts gained 3 regression cases pinning the aliasing/forks/cutoff/busiestWeek so the next migration cannot drop them again. 4 of 4 tests pass. Build clean. Webhook deploy fired on push of 17279c7; new bundle index-DUNHjrGI.js live at /var/www/monitor.vaultwares.ca. Snapshot data.json untouched; the named/auto commit-outlier constants in api.ts are ready for when the API ever returns commitSamples we can re-aggregate.

- Summary: Deployed shared-tube v0.2.18 (SHA 8146d18) + vaultwares-api v0.1.11 (SHA 46f170e). ROOT CAUSE for the still-underlined links and invisible stars: Layout.astro's <style> block was scoped (Astro default cid-attribute scoping), so every site-wide rule I'd written only matched anchors carrying Layout's cid â€” i.e. zero descendants. Adding is:global made all the rules I'd shipped previously (no-underline + gold star + .st-studio-icon + pill exceptions) actually reach VideoCard / TaxonomyRail / SuggestionStrip / Header / Footer. Also dropped the decorative ::after-bar approach (too much false-positive coverage), switched star glyph from U+2B50 to U+2605 for reliable cross-font rendering, applied user's exact .st-studio-icon CSS (margin-right:5px, vertical-align:middle, margin-bottom:1px), added svg { overflow: visible !important } for the thumbs-down icon halo. New: default movie-clapper SVG fallback for favicon route (no more 204 gaps), drag-to-scroll on every horizontal chip strip ([data-chip-strip], .st-header__menu/nav, .st-suggestions__list, .st-footer__searches-grid) via global pointer event script with 6px movement threshold to swallow accidental clicks, removed footer max-width:78ch, Pagination windowSize 2â†’4 (now shows up to 9 inline numeric buttons) + new countVideos() client method + every category/actor/studio/search/videos-index page in all 4 apps fetches total in parallel and passes totalPages to <Pagination>. NEW SCHEMA: ALTER TABLE videos ADD COLUMN description TEXT applied directly to live OVH:5433/promking via psql (additive, no data loss). Drizzle schema + VideoDetail pydantic model + get_video SQL all updated. New VideoDescription.astro shared component: SSR-renders full text (SEO-friendly) but client-side clamps to 3 lines with Show more/less toggle that auto-hides when content already fits, wired into all 4 detail pages. fullvideos.ts now extracts description from .video_description / .description / .info_video

Polish pass: global link styling (no underline anywhere, replaced with a 2px accent bar that grows from centre on hover; pills/header brand/sidebar rail opt out); pornstar gold star via global a[href^=/actor/]::before so every model link site-wide gets a brand-tinted â­ with no per-template work; studio favicons extended to TaxonomyRail, SuggestionStrip (auto-detected via /studio/ href), and studio detail h1 â€” .st-studio-icon resized to 1.15em with -0.18em vertical-align so it scales with font and sits on baseline; TaxonomyRail title differentiation (gradient accent banners with inset shadow, bordered card frame, PKT keeps minimal style via brand override); new /category/trending, /actor/trending, /studio/trending hubs in all 4 apps (12 files) using new shared TaxonomyDirectory.astro component, with baked-in simulated fallback term lists so the pages are never blank even when the catalog is empty (per user 'simulate the trends, as long as the pages show something'); Footer rewrite â€” long marketing about paragraph + ~75-chip trending-searches cloud matching the user's fullvideos.xxx reference screenshot, generic fallback ensures every page gets the SEO surface; Layout.astro hardcoded <!-- v0.2.5 --> replaced with dynamic Fragment; fetcher: FetchedVideo gains views?:number|null, fullvideos.ts parses listing .wrap badge via new parseViewsCount() handling 12.5K/1.2M/1,234 forms, vaultwares-api persists it on INSERT (coerced to int, 0 on missing). - Summary: Multi-part feature pass (NOT YET DEPLOYED to greencloud, per user 'do other tasks before deploying then'). Bumped shared-tube root + @promking/shared-tube to 0.2.15. (1) UI: sexyprn-specific .st-header__nav a:hover override paints the nav button background var(--accent-text)=white with --accent label color so the hover area is visible on the dark header (default 8% accent-alpha rgba was invisible on the light theme's high-contrast palette). (2) UI: global rule in Layout.astro removes hover underline from .st-pill / [data-chip-strip] / .st-suggestions__list / .st-header__menu anchors (global a:hover { text-decoration: underline } was bleeding through). (3) UI: added view-count increment endpoint. vaultwares-api: new POST /api/promking/videos/{slug}/view in app/routers/promking/videos.py that bumps videos.views and updated_at. Client: new incrementViews(site, slug) on PromKingApiClient in shared/src/api/promking-api.ts. Call site: each of the 4 apps/<site>/src/pages/videos/[slug].astro now fires-and-forgets the bump on every detail SSR + optimistically +1s the rendered video.views so the user sees the new count immediately. (4) Favicon system using DuckDuckGo icon proxy. New module shared/src/favicon/index.ts (exported via @promking/shared-tube/favicon): studioHost(slug) derives <slug>.com with a baked-in override map for the common multi-word studios (brazzers/naughty-america/team-skeet/etc.) + STUDIO_HOSTS_JSON env for runtime extension. getStudioFavicon(slug) reads from / writes to FAVICON_CACHE_DIR (/srv/cache/favicons in prod, ./.cache/favicons in dev) with 30-day positive TTL + 6-hour negative cache (.miss markers prevent DDG hammering). Heuristic: DDG <200 byte response = placeholder, treated as miss. New API route /api/favicon/studio/[slug] in each of 4 apps streams cached bytes (Blob-wrapped to satisfy DOM Response BodyInit) with 1-day browser cache + 7-day shared-CDN cache; returns 204 on miss so <img onerror> fallback fires. UI: studio favicon <img class='st-studio-icon'> rendered next to studio name
- Commands:
  - `pnpm --filter @promking/shared-tube exec tsc --noEmit -p .`
  - `pnpm -r --filter '@promking/site-*' exec tsc --noEmit -p .`
  - `python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(...))'`

- Summary: Fix /api/stream/[slug] returning 502 for what is really a 404. The handler now: (a) catches PromKingApiError(404) and surfaces it as 404 instead of generic 'API error' 502; (b) returns 404 (not 502) when source page fetch succeeds but contains zero <source> tags â€” this is the case the user hit (sexyprn cum-fantasy) and 502 was triggering NS_BINDING_ABORTED in the browser; (c) tries EVERY DB-stored quality URL in preference order on the fast path, not just the single picked one (one stale signed URL no longer kills the whole request); (d) tries every freshly extracted source URL on the slow path; (e) falls back to embedUrl when extraction yields zero sources; (f) widens the site query-param cast from 'fxv'|'pkt' to the full Site union so oneporn/sexyprn type cleanly. Replaced pickUrl() with orderCandidates() that returns ALL candidates sorted by preference. Edited apps/sexyprn/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts and synced to fxv/oneporn/pkt (the 4 files were byte-identical before and after). Type-check clean on all 4 apps. Tue, 24 Jun 2026.
- Commands:
  - `pnpm --filter @promking/site-sexyprn exec tsc --noEmit -p .`
  - `pnpm --filter @promking/site-fxv --filter @promking/site-pkt --filter @promking/site-oneporn exec tsc --noEmit -p .`
- Files:
  - `shared-tube/apps/sexyprn/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts`
  - `shared-tube/apps/fxv/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts`
  - `shared-tube/apps/oneporn/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts`
  - `shared-tube/apps/pkt/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts`
- Git: repo=shared-tube, branch=main, head=0c92d3b

- Summary: Three pipeline fixes + nginx vhost for theitguyde.com. - Summary: tech-oracle: cross-encoder reranker added to RAG pipeline (Tue, 23 Jun 2026). User flagged we forgot reranking. Also raised Qwen3 question - clarified Gemini does NOT use Qwen3 (uses Google's own text-embedding-005), but Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B IS a strong open option (~+8-9 MTEB points over BGE-small). Recommended adding reranker BEFORE swapping embedder because the specific failure we saw (Chrome-Stable-Update scoring 0.65 against macOS-Photos query by 'update' keyword) is a textbook cross-encoder fix; Qwen3 swap is corpus-density-bound. Build: tech_oracle/rag/rerank.py wraps fastembed.rerank.cross_encoder.TextCrossEncoder (ONNX, no torch dep). Default BAAI/bge-reranker-base (~1GB, ~280M params). Outputs sigmoid-normalized 0-1 scores. retrieve_related_per_item now does two-stage flow by default: bi-encoder recall (pull top_k*5 at min_score 0.45) then cross-encoder precision (drop <0.4 rerank, return top_k). SearchHit.score gets replaced with the rerank score so downstream prompts see the more meaningful number. CLI rag search is rerank-on by default with --no-rerank escape; output table shows both rerank and bi-encoder scores. Live test on the actual 65-item corpus PROVED the value: 'my printer wont print after windows update' query - bi-encoder had near-flat 0.67-0.73 top-5, reranker found ONE clearly-best HP-driver-complaint item and promoted 0.674->0.821 while demoting all other printer chatter to <0.15. 'macos icloud photos stuck' query - bi-encoder returned 8 false-positives in 0.55-0.57 band (Chrome updates, unrelated printer items); reranker zeroed EVERY ONE to 0.000 (corpus genuinely has no macOS-Photos content; correct behavior). Distribution is decisively bimodal vs bi-encoder mushy 0.4-0.7: rerank says match=0.5+, plausible=0.1-0.5, no-match=<0.05. Cost: one-time 90s 1GB download; ~30-50ms per pair on CPU; ~5-7s extra per synthesis batch (well within budget). UTF-8 stdout fix applied to cli.py module

- Summary: tech-oracle: embedding model benchmark + RAG-augmented synthesis wired (Tue, 23 Jun 2026). User asked for concrete numbers on bigger embedding models + live-vs-cron tradeoff, then to wire retrieval into synthesis. Benchmark inline (tests/benchmark_embed.py + resource_compat.py) compared BGE-small vs BGE-base on the same 65-item live corpus. Results: BGE-base is 2.8x slower per item (193.9 ms vs 69.5 ms), uses ~500MB more RSS (1567 vs 1068 MB), disk 1.75x (0.223 MB vs 0.127 MB at 65 items). Surprise: BGE-small actually scored HIGHER on direct-match queries (printer 0.731 vs 0.707, outlook 0.597 vs 0.541) - BGE-base's only clear win was better off-topic category discrimination (returned tech-news instead of printer noise on spacex query). Recommendation: stay on BGE-small until corpus reaches ~10k items. Live-vs-cron: both invisible on Clopeux at our load (sustained <0.1% CPU, ~120ms bursts per item). Cron simpler operationally; daemon offers freshness in minutes which we dont need. Build: tech_oracle/rag/retrieve.py with retrieve_related_per_item(items, rag_store, top_k, min_score) and hit_to_compact helper. Filters items in current batch out of results (only HISTORICAL context surfaces). Prompts: _compact_item now takes optional related[] argument; build_user_message takes related_past_items dict[item_id, list[dict]] and appends a NOTE telling the model to use them for dedup/clustering only - never for citations. Synthesize signature gained rag_store/rag_top_k/rag_min_score kwargs (defaults: 3 / 0.65); cleanly no-ops if lancedb/fastembed unavailable. CLI predict has --rag --rag-top-k --rag-min-score --lance flags. End-to-end test on the consumer fixture with --rag --refine: 2m50s wall, 12919 tokens, 7 predictions all with grandma-readable discrete step bullets, no-fix predictions correctly hit the 'Wait for the vendor' fallback + refine notes. - Summary: tech-oracle local RAG: lancedb + fastembed BGE-small (Mon, 22 Jun 2026 23:55 -> Tue, 23 Jun 2026). Picked the lightweight path the user worried about: ONNX-runtime BGE-small-en-v1.5 (no torch dep; ~150-300MB RAM, CPU-only) via fastembed, lancedb as embedded single-process vector store (no etcd/MinIO sidecars unlike Milvus). New deps: lancedb>=0.13, fastembed>=0.4 (brought onnxruntime, pyarrow, tokenizers - NO torch). New module tech_oracle/rag/{embed,store}.py: embed.py wraps fastembed.TextEmbedding with lazy lru_cache + normalize-to-unit + zero-vector for empty strings; store.py opens/creates a lancedb table 'items' with item_id+metadata+vec(384), search() returns SearchHit dataclasses with cosine similarity converted from L2 distance (vectors are unit-normalized so cosine = 1 - L2_sq/2). New SQLite migration: indexed_at column + items_indexed_idx. New store methods: recent_unindexed, mark_indexed, get_by_ids; stats() now reports unindexed count. New CLI: tech-oracle rag {index,search,stats}. UTF-8 stdout reconfigure at cli.py module top to fix UnicodeEncodeError from emoji in Reddit titles (Windows cp1252 codec breaks Rich tables on U+1F62B etc). Smoke test on the 65-item corpus: cold first-run 14.93s including 5-file ~6s model download; warm subsequent embedding ~120ms/item; lancedb disk 0.143 MB for 65 vectors (projected ~140MB at 100k); per-query warm latency ~200ms. Real semantic search proved working: 'my printer wont print after windows update' returned r/printers items with scores 0.731-0.712 (no literal word match - true semantic recall); 'outlook keeps crashing' returned 0.575 max (correctly low - we have ZERO outlook items in the index yet, signal scaling exactly as expected); 'spacex starship mars rocket' returned no hits above 0.5 (no false positives on unrelated queries). Resource verdict: invisible on a desktop being actively used - ComfyUI

- Summary: Built Prom-King/tech-oracle (Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:00): a focused synthesis service for the tech-support prediction pipeline. Calls NVIDIA NIM Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (free build.nvidia.com endpoint via NGC_API_KEY/NVIDIA_API_KEY) to turn pre-ingested news/changelog items + deterministic Postgres breakage scores into ranked TechPrediction objects. Layout: uv-managed pyproject.toml (Python 3.11+), src/tech_oracle/{client,schemas,prompts,synthesize,cli,api}.py, tests/fixtures/sample_request.json (handcrafted realistic 2026-06 batch: KB5039340 Win11 24H2 wifi, Anthropic claude-2-5-sonnet deprecation, Copilot Pro price hike 2026-07-15, macOS 15.7 Keychain visibility change, Chrome 141 WebGPU/extensions breakage, NVIDIA 558.20 HDR/OBS bug + 6 breakage scores). Hard rules baked into the prompt: JSON-only output, every prediction must cite source_item_ids, must use provided scores as-given (no inventing stats), calibrated confidence (high needs >=2 corroborating items AND strong vendor breakage history), bias toward missing over inventing, kebab-case prediction_id slugs. Stack is dependency-light: httpx + pydantic + fastapi + typer + rich. Smoke test against real NIM 70B: 1m11s, 4975 tokens (3127 in / 1848 out), 6 predictions all schema-valid, all with citations and reasoning that references the supplied breakage scores. Calibration looked right: only the KB5039340 wifi item got HIGH/next_24h; the Anthropic deprecation 3 months out correctly got LOW/watch. Two fixes during testing: bumped default NIM timeout 120s->300s (env-overridable as NIM_TIMEOUT) because 70B with JSON mode + heavy prompt regularly takes >2min on free tier; relaxed PredictionResponse.usage from dict[str,int] to dict[str,Any] because NIM returns prompt_tokens_details=None. Service is library + CLI + FastAPI POST /predict, all hitting the same synthesize() function. Not deployed - lives locally under Prom-King/tech-oracle/ pending downstream pipeline pieces (Brave Search/RSS ingester, 8B enrichment worker, Postgres scoring DB, publishing CMS).

- Summary: Investigated 500 on /api/promking/videos?actor_gender=female (and equivalent on /taxonomies/pornstars?gender=female). Root cause: pornstars.gender is a Postgres ENUM (gender) but the filter does gender = ANY($N::text[]), which Postgres rejects without a cast. Affects videos.list_videos, videos.get_video, taxonomies.list_terms, taxonomies.count_terms. 'all' / 'null' paths work because they avoid the ANY comparison. - Summary: Five fixes for streaming UX. (1) js/streaming/rd-flow.js startRDDebridFlow: 'response is not defined' ReferenceError on stream re-open caused by let response = await... being block-scoped inside the for-loop; the post-loop branch then read undefined 'response' when no attempt succeeded (e.g. all 5 fallbacks failed on a freshly-cached but already-added magnet). Hoisted let response = null above the loop. (2) js/streaming/rd-flow.js triggerRDStream: always auto-pick the best ranked torrent that matches the user's quality ceiling and start the flow immediately (~400ms toast); the manual list is still pre-rendered hidden so the existing 'Choose Manually' button on the loading screen reveals it as an escape hatch. Removed the isAutoSelectEnabled() conditional. (3) js/streaming/trailer.js YouTube embed: previous fix passed origin=file://... (Electron) which YouTube rejects. Switched to youtube-nocookie.com, only pass origin when running from http(s), added a window-level postMessage listener that catches IFrame API onError codes 2/5/100/101/150 and auto-flips to the 'Open in YouTube' fallback button, plus a listening-handshake postMessage on iframe load. (4) index.html streaming top bar: replaced the 3-row toolbar (title row / subtab row / providers row) with a single 42px-tall row containing [Movies][Series] | [All][Netflix][Disney+][Apple TV+][Prime] | margin-auto [Search input + button]. Dropped the redundant 'Streaming' title (the main tab bar already shows it) and the 'Watch Providers:' label. (5) index.css + js/navigation/tabs.js: body now gets a tab-<name>-active class on every switch; body.tab-streaming-active .main-area gets padding:0 / overflow:hidden and #tmdb-container fills 100% width/height so the streaming surface is truly full-bleed. Static-only verification: node --check on all 3 touched JS files.

- Summary: Revised the Real-Debrid torrent ranking algorithm in js/streaming.js. Fixes: (1) word-boundary regex so 'ts' no longer matches DTS audio, 'cam' no longer matches camera/campaign - previously most quality releases with DTS audio were penalized -10000 as Telesyncs. (2) Replaced N-concurrent checkRDCached Promise.all storm with a single batched checkRDCachedBatch() that uses RD's multi-hash instantAvailability endpoint (40 hashes per call, 250ms gap between chunks) - protects against rate-limiting. (3) Richer scoring: source tier (remux>bluray>web-dl>webrip>hdtv>dvdrip), codec bonus (AV1/HEVC>AVC), HDR/DV tier (DV>HDR10+>HDR), Atmos/TrueHD/DTS-HD bonus, log-curve seeder health with dead-torrent penalty, size sanity (rejects fake 4K under 6GB and oversized over 80GB remuxes per quality tier), encoder reputation (YIFY penalty, FraMeSToR/QxR/etc bonus). (4) Quality scoring now rewards exact match of the user's preferred quality ceiling more strongly (+100 vs scaled tq*15).

Per-video pruning is the point: with combined-set pruning a 348s cloudy + 130s sunny would land 73% cloudy. Base-job merge still runs last with a base_ prefix. Net: sunny (base) ~280 + cloudy1 ~280 + cloudy2 ~280 = ~840 frames into one COLMAP run.

Reason: setFromEuler discarded any roll introduced by Flip Up, so after the user righted the scene their mouselook felt inverted; premultiply preserves it. Pitch clamp via |forward.dot(worldUp)| < cos(~1deg) instead of explicit Euler clamp. (b) Cached SceneBounds in ViewportTab keyed on (preview_ply path, mtime). bounds_from_preview_ply was reading 200K points and running np.percentile on every Apply+Preview Pattern click — measured hundreds of ms felt by user as ~1.5s mode-switch pause. _get_bounds_cached returns the cached instance; set_job invalidates.

- Summary: Added FPS pointer-lock camera mode to viewer.js. Right-click+hold locks the cursor and enters game-style mouselook (yaw around world +Y, pitch around camera-right, roll forced to 0 via Euler YXZ, pitch clamped to +/-89deg). WASD walks along camera horizontal-forward (pitch does not slow walking); QE raises/lowers along world up. On lock, OrbitControls is disabled; on release, target snaps to camera_pos + forward*3 so capture poses and post-FPS orbit pivot stay coherent. Also enforced camera.up=(0,1,0) at scene load so gravity-aligned splats no longer start upside down (removes need to hit Flip Up on every load). Status line updated to advertise the new control. captureCamera() unchanged — still derives lookAt from controls.target, which the FPS handler keeps on the camera ray.

- Summary: Four worker + preset changes for SfM robustness, all in docker/worker/recon_entrypoint.py and presets.py. (1) retry_mapper: 2 -> 4 progressively-relaxed attempts. Original 2 (init_min_tri_angle 8/4, inliers 50/30) plus 2 new (init_min_tri_angle 2/1.5, inliers 20/15, abs_pose_min_num_inliers 10/8). Each attempt ~2 min, so 4 attempts = ~8 min insurance before giving up on the mapper init lottery. (2) Matching loop swapped 'exhaustive' for 'vocab_tree'. Added ensure_vocab_tree() helper that lazily downloads vocab_tree_flickr100K_words256K.bin from demuc.de/colmap on first use, caches at /tmp/. ns-process-data invocation appends --vocab-tree-path when matching=vocab_tree. Falls back gracefully (stops at sequential) if download fails. vocab_tree is O(n log n) vs exhaustive's O(n^2), runs in ~10 min instead of 30-45, and catches loop closures sequential misses. (3) MIN_REGISTERED dynamic: new MIN_REGISTERED_RATIO=0.5 constant, per-job target = max(MIN_REGISTERED_IMAGES=10, frame_count * 0.5). For typical 280-frame job, fails at <140 instead of <10. Error message rewritten to point at scene texture + capture motion + lighting + glass/water/mirror traps. (4) presets.py standard: downscale_factor 2 -> 1 (full-res training), est_minutes 35 -> 60. Tradeoff: 4x pixels per training iteration but sharper final splat. Standard remains DEFAULT_PRESET_KEY. Draft and high left unchanged. Worker syntax compiles, full suite 77/77 still passes. CHANGES NOT YET DEPLOYED: worker image must be rebuilt via tools/push_worker_space.py before next remote recon picks up the changes.

- Summary: Second consecutive HF Job COLMAP failure on user's video input. Status: still RUNNING in exhaustive matching fallback (HF Job 6a2c2ff4871c005b5352b55b on backyard_134s_sunny.mp4), 25 min in. Sequential matching finished retry_mapper 2 with 2/270 images registered. Root cause is input video quality, not pipeline: keypoint match rate is 150-180/5000-8000 = 2-3% between consecutive frames. SfM needs ~20%+ for stable registration. Backyards are a known-hard SfM target due to (a) large textureless areas (grass, sidewalks, sky), (b) repeating textures (fence slats, lawn) that produce false matches, (c) sunlight shadow drift between frames. Yesterday's cloudy backyard succeeding 280/280 was lucky given the same underlying constraints. Recommended user re-record with: textured scene focus (around plants/structures, not open lawn), slower camera movement (70%+ frame overlap), consistent lighting (cloudy actually beats sunny for SfM). Awaiting user decision: kill now (lose ~0.33 USD), let exhaustive finish (probably succeeds but 30-45 min more + 0.40-0.60 USD more), or accept partial reconstruction.

- Summary: Two viewport fixes. (1) viewer.js:197 'undefined position' crash on Apply+Preview Pattern. Root cause: requestAnimationFrame's now and performance.now() use slightly different time bases in QtWebEngine, so on the very first step (now - startedAt) can be slightly negative, Math.floor gives -1, Math.min(frames.length-1, -1) is -1, frames[-1] is undefined, frame.position throws. Fix: clamp index with Math.max(0, ...) and add defensive guard that re-schedules instead of crashing if frame is malformed. (2) Camera angle presets to unstick from confusing poses. New JS hooks: window.snapToView('top'|'bottom'|'front'|'back'|'left'|'right'|'iso') snaps the orbit camera to a named world-space direction at the current orbit distance, forces world +Y up, dodges the gimbal pole when snapping straight vertical. window.flipCameraUp() rolls 180 deg around the forward axis (negates camera.up + re-lookAt) for one-click 'right myself'. New compact button grid in viewport panel: Top/Front/Side/Iso/Flip Up via QGridLayout (2x2 + full-width flip row). Strings in EN+QC. Suite: 77/77 pass, ViewportTab imports clean.

- Summary: Three viewer.js fixes for navigation + pointer behavior. (1) Pointer-leave teleport fix: OrbitControls calls setPointerCapture but QtWebEngine does not reliably forward pointer events once the cursor leaves the WebEngine widget bounds, so the drag never receives pointerup and the next pointermove on re-entry registers a huge delta. Tracking active pointers on the renderer canvas and dispatching a synthetic pointerup on pointerleave cleanly ends the drag. (2) Real WASD fly: the status text already advertised 'WASD to fly' but the vendored OrbitControls only does arrow-key pan, so the user could only arc around the orbit target and never translate toward an arbitrary point (the 'can't go toward the house' issue). Added a heldKeys set + requestAnimationFrame loop that translates BOTH camera.position and controls.target by the same delta â€” the orbit pivot moves with the camera so WASD reads as first-person walking. W/S = forward/back along the look vector, A/D = strafe via right = forward x up, E/Q = world-up raise/lower. Shift triples speed. blur listener clears the held set so alt-tabbing doesn't leave keys stuck. Speed scales with orbit distance so the same key feel works far and close. (3) Updated status text to reflect the actual control set. Full test suite (excluding test_viewer_server which we already skipped): 68/68 pass.

- Summary: Fixed real regression in dashboard->viewport job sync. Root cause: DashboardWidget._load_existing_job (gui_app.py:1280) is the handler for both 'Open Latest Job' and 'Open Job Manifest' buttons; it updated self.manifest and called _render_manifest but never emitted signals.manifest_changed. The ViewportTab listens for that signal at gui_app.py:1598 and calls set_job from it. No emit means no set_job means viewport keeps the initial _job_dir from app startup (typically the most-recent half-completed job that has no cloud.ply). reload_scene takes the splat-doesn't-exist branch, web_view.load(url) gets a bare URL with no scene= query, and viewer.js shows 'No scene loaded'. The signal IS emitted from the job-runner code path (gui_app.py:1372-1374) which is why the viewport works immediately after running a job but not after just opening one. User confirmed with screenshots: dashboard correctly on local-run-20260610-165858, Open3D fallback viewer renders the splat, but the QWebEngine viewport tab is stuck on 'No scene loaded' despite reload. Two-line fix: emit self.signals.manifest_changed.emit(manifest) at the end of _load_existing_job with comment explaining the dependency. Full test suite: 67/67 pass. Not an alignment bug, not an env/PySide bug â€” pre-existing wiring regression that masqueraded as the user's 'always broken' state.

- Summary: Implemented gravity-alignment baked into reconstruction stage. New vaultwares_studio/gravity_align.py: PCA on preview cloud picks smallest-variance axis as scene up, skewness-of-projections heuristic resolves sign (sparse sky tail = +up), Rodrigues rotation sends that axis to +Y. Applies rotation to (a) cloud.ply positions and per-splat quaternions via composed Hamilton product, (b) cloud_preview.ply positions, (c) summary.json (gravity_aligned flag + alignment matrix block). Idempotent: skips if summary.gravity_aligned. SH bands 1-3 (f_rest) deliberately left untouched â€” known limitation documented in module docstring; geometry correct, view-dependent shading subtly drifts. Wired into pipeline._run_reconstruction after PLY conversion via new _gravity_align method on DigitalTwinStudioRunner. Best-effort: catches and logs unless strict_mode. Hit a Windows mmap lock bug in plyfile during read->write of the same path; fixed by deep-copying arrays via _detach_splat + gc.collect to release the mmap. Tests: tests/test_gravity_align.py (7 cases) all pass. Full run: 27/27 across gravity_align + walk_patterns + camera_paths. End-to-end verified on local-run-20260610-165858: pre-alignment up axis = (-0.09, -0.04, 0.995) at 87.53 deg off +Y; post-alignment thin axis is aligned to Y, splat count preserved at 477731, sh_rest shape (477731, 45) intact. Backup at reconstruction/pre_align_backup/. Follow-up: walk_patterns.retrace_steps consumes transforms.json poses that may be in pre-alignment frame; deferred (not implemented this turn).

PKT: added pkt_actor + pkt_studio taxonomies; tightened per-source XPath (xvideos requires video_<digits> + non-channel anchor, xhamster requires /videos/ link, spankbang requires /<key>/video/); added URL_REJECT_PATTERNS (channels/playlists/profiles/series) and CONTENT_REJECT_PATTERNS ('Trust and Safety', 'podcast', 'episode', etc.) to fix prior PH-podcast contamination; redtube API handler now extracts actors from stars/models/pornstars + applies same content filters; added handle_wipe_and_backfill admin handler (requires typed WIPE confirmation) that deletes every pkt_video post, clears seen+cursors+poisoned keywords, then runs bulk fetch across xvideos+xhamster+spankbang+redtube targeting ~50 pages each. Shared: rewrote pkt-player.bundle.js to support hls.js via jsdelivr CDN for non-Safari browsers, added 'unsupported' player mode with source-page link CTA, removed automatic iframe fallback on HLS failures; mirrored JS+CSS to both plugins. Templates: reduced FXV archive inline ad (12->24), removed FXV in-player overlay ad, reduced PKT archive inline ad (3->15), removed PKT below-embed ad slot, added actor+studio chip rows to single-video templates. CSS: added .pkt-player-modal__unsupported + credit chip styles; harmonized PKT brand-icon fallback paths and play-icon fallback SVG (removed lone emoji). All modified PHP lints clean.

- Summary: Round 3 feedback fixes â€” eight items. (1) CRITICAL bug fix: prompts/textareas were uneditable because FlowCanvas initialized rfNodes from storeNodes once and never re-synced. Added a useEffect in FlowCanvas that propagates store data changes (params, label) to rfNodes while leaving position/measured state untouched (preserves the visibility:hidden fix from earlier sessions). Identity-checks on params and label avoid spurious re-renders. (2) Toast system: new src/ui/components/Toast.tsx with module-level event hub (pushToast/dismissToast from anywhere) and ToastHost mounted at App root; renders top-right stack with auto-dismiss (6s default, 4s for success); three tones (error/success/info) with matching tokens. App.tsx now pushes 'success' on clean run, 'error' on per-node or top-level failure + auto-opens the inspector. (3) Execution errors moved to TOP of NodeParamPanel â€” banner with the failure detail + a Reset button; the old bottom error block was removed. Per-node text/json outputs still render below (image results render inline ON the comfyui_workflow node). (4) Removed the auto-created Display node from loadFromComfyWorkflow; the master flow is now just the single comfyui_workflow node, with results rendering inline (gallery + thumbnails). Eliminates the disconnected 'Result' node that felt orphaned. (5) Inline image result on ComfyUIWorkflowNode: when the workflow succeeds and the result has imageUrl/imageUrls, the gallery renders inside the node card itself; click any thumb opens full-size in a new tab. (6) New InlineSeedInput in canvas/nodes/inline.tsx â€” number input with a dice button (Lucide Dice5) that fills a 31-bit random int. ComfyUIWorkflowNode routes any input key named 'seed' through this control. (7) Size presets dropdown â€” when a workflow exposes both 'width' and 'height' in input_paths, a single 'size' InlineSelect drives both (512Â², 768Â², 1024Â², portrait/landscape variants, Custom reveals manual w/h number inputs). Exported SIZE_PRESETS array from inline.tsx. (8) NodeId pill â€” small mono badge at the bottom of every node card showing 'node#<short-id>'; tooltip on hover reveals the full id. shortenNodeId helper formats numeric/short/UUID ids consistently. (9) Persisted last-used inputs: ComfyUIWorkflowNode reads localStorage['vw:lastInputs:<workflow_id>'] on mount if all inputs are empty, prefills non-image fields (upload tokens excluded â€” they expire); debounced 400ms save on every input change. Each user gets their own browser-local memory of last prompt/seed/size per workflow. Deployed dist (assets/index-BxACQy3N.js).

- Summary: Identified and fixed the real cause of the startup crash. After scanning a directory, the frontend called schedule-idle-previews with all items. For large folders or cloud directories (like iCloud Photos with 2,100+ items), this ran over 6,000 synchronous I/O operations (fs.existsSync) in a single loop on the main process thread, blocking the Electron main thread and triggering a native access violation crash/watchdog lock. Optimized the handler in previews.js to skip automatic background previews for cloud-backed directories (iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox, etc.) and limited active batch size to 80 items in other folders. Rebuilt installer successfully.

- Summary: Landed A2: full real-time progress + cancel for comfyui_workflow nodes. Backend (vaultwares-pipelines): added websockets dependency (16.0) to .venv + requirements.txt. _execute_comfyui_graph now takes optional progress_cb + cancel_event args. Spawns _comfyui_ws_listener as an asyncio.Task that subscribes to ws://127.0.0.1:8188/ws?clientId=<id>, filters events by prompt_id, calls progress_cb with executing/progress/executed/execution_error/execution_success/execution_cached events. If cancel_event is set during execution, POSTs to ComfyUI's /interrupt and raises RuntimeError('canceled'). _execute_workflow_run plumbs both through. Job worker creates: (a) a progress_cb closure that maintains a progress_state dict and writes it to job.progress with throttling (~5 Hz), (b) a watch_cancel asyncio.Task that polls the job record once per second and sets cancel_event when status==canceled. JobSummary/JobDetail gained a progress field. New GET /jobs/recent endpoint (registered before /jobs/{job_id} to avoid the same path-conflict the validation endpoint hit) returns the caller's most recently-updated job, filterable by kind and CSV status; admins see all jobs, non-admins only their own (matched via requested_by.username or special 'vault-flows' tag). Frontend (vault-flows): listed JobSummary + JobProgress types in client.ts; getRecentJob(opts) handles the 'null' body case; cancelJob(id) calls POST /jobs/{id}/cancel. New ExecutionProgressOverlay.tsx renders a fixed bottom-right card while executionStatus==='running' â€” polls /jobs/recent at 1 Hz, shows a pulsing accent dot, progress bar (when total>0), current message, node + step counter, elapsed time, and a Cancel button that calls cancelJob. App.tsx mounts the overlay. Verified end-to-end: started a 30-step run, observed live step progress (poll showed step 4/12, then step 2/30 etc, with current node id 3), POST /jobs/{id}/cancel mid-execution â†’ worker tripped /interrupt â†’ /flows/run returned with error='ComfyUI workflow was canceled', final job status=canceled. Frontend (src/api/client.ts): setToken/getToken now read/write sessionStorage key 'vw_jwt' with try/catch fallback to in-memory. Added clearToken() for use on stale-token detection. App.tsx: useEffect on mount that, if getToken() is set, calls getMe() and either rehydrates currentUser (success) or calls clearToken()+nulls user (401). This makes page refresh in the same tab keep the user logged in, while tab close still clears the token. Pipelines (.env): JWT_TTL_SECONDS=3600 â€” verified via login -> JWT payload exp-iat=3600s. - Summary: Three workflow-toolchain improvements addressing 'workflow runs in ComfyUI but fails validation' false positives. (1) Converter (convert_proven_workflows.py): skips nodes with mode==2 (muted) and mode==4 (bypassed); for bypassed nodes, rewires consumer links from bypassed_node.output[N] to whatever feeds bypassed_node.input[N], following chains of bypasses. This is exactly what ComfyUI's editor's 'Bypass' mode does at runtime. Eliminates dangling links + 'missing model' false positives where the referenced model was in a bypassed node. (2) Fixer (fix_workflows.py): smarter _core_key() that strips quant markers (FP16/FP8/Q2_K/etc), distillation markers (DMD/DMD2/distilled), AIO/base tags, and minor-version suffixes (V1.0/V1.1/v1-1) â€” so different-quant or patch-version files of the same base model are treated as drop-in substitutes. Closest_match() now uses the core-key tier as high-confidence matching (returns first match, prefers top-level files over nested copies). Also added Pass 3: normalize_load_image_widgets() replaces baked-in LoadImage filenames with a placeholder ('000.jpeg' from D:\\comfyui\\resources\\comfyui\\inputs) so ComfyUI's validator passes; the worker overrides at runtime. (3) Diagnostic (dump_workflows_diagnostic.py): validate_locally() now exempts LoadImage's image input from validation for any node referenced by step.image_inputs[] â€” runtime-overridden inputs are never structurally broken from the worker's POV. Re-seeded: 13/13 workflows now match the fixed JSONs (muted nodes dropped, bypasses rewired). New verdict tally: PASS=3 (biglove-photo, ipadapter-faceswap, z-image-turbo-text2img), BLOCKED_SUBGRAPH=4 (custom-realistic, flux-conditioner-sampler-upscaler, qwen-image-text2img, gonzalomo-dmd-v30), BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_PACK=3 (copilot/flux2-klein-faceswap/wan22 â€” AI-invented), BROKEN_WIRING=2 (basic-lora-text2img orphan upscale chain, qwen-edit-multi-angle unwired CLIP), BLOCKED_MISSING_MODEL=1 (openpose-i2i), VALIDATION_OTHER=1 (qwen-image-edit-4step references muted ReferenceLatent). All remaining issues are real workflow content problems requiring editor surgery.

(2) src/store/flowStore.ts gained a workflowsById cache + two new actions: setPipelinesWorkflows (called by WorkflowLibrary on mount) and loadFromComfyWorkflow(workflow) which builds a synthetic 2-node Flow ([comfyui_workflow with workflow_id+empty inputs] -> [display]), wires the edge, embeds _input_paths/_image_inputs hints on the node for the editor, and auto-selects the workflow node so the inputs panel opens immediately. (3) src/ui/WorkflowLibrary.tsx: new sidebar component, fetches /api/workflows once on mount, renders category-tab filter + clickable cards per workflow showing name/description/input-count. Click -> loadFromComfyWorkflow + closes sidebar. (4) src/ui/ComfyUIWorkflowInputsEditor.tsx: structured editor that pulls input_paths/image_inputs (cache-first, falls back to per-node hint fields, falls back to GET /workflows/{id}) and renders one labeled field per declared input â€” file picker w/ upload+preview for image_inputs, number input for seed/steps/width/height/cfg/denoise/strength keys, textarea for positive_prompt/negative_prompt/prompt/system/template, plain text otherwise. Writes back into params.inputs[key]. Also exposes workflow_id (read-only) + mode (local/nim) settings. (5) src/ui/NodeParamPanel.tsx routes node.type=='comfyui_workflow' to the structured editor; filters underscore-prefixed hint keys from the generic param loop. (6) src/App.tsx swaps PresetLibrary for WorkflowLibrary in the sidebar; renames the header toggle and empty-state CTA accordingly. Backend: added GET /workflows/{id} to api_server.py (the SPA editor falls back to this when the workflow isn't in cache). Deployed dist (assets/index-DbffKEaM.js) atomically to /var/www/vault-flows/dist on greencloud-vps; both flows.vaultwares.ca and noddit.org now serve the new bundle. Verified: catalog GET returns 14 workflows with input_paths/image_inputs, singular GET works (200 / 404), bundle hash matches on both hostnames.
